{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ygp9","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: Ack write_to/from_bytes_for has incompatible wire formats","description":"The diff changed Ack::write_to to use bit-packed bitmap encoding via set_bit starting at out[1] bit 2, with out[2] = n as u8. For positions 8-15, set_bit writes to out[2], overwriting the N field byte that was just stored.

Meanwhile, from_bytes_for still reads N from data[2] as a raw byte value and reads bitmap bytes from data[3..] (byte-aligned).

These two wire formats are incompatible:
- Writer produces: [rule_id][window|bitmap_bits][n|bitmap_bits][more_bitmap]...
- Reader expects: [rule_id][header][N][bitmap_bytes]...

The canonical check at line 342 (write_to → compare with original) will fail for any non-complete ACK with a non-zero bitmap, always returning NonCanonicalAck. This breaks the core ACK-on-Error retransmission mechanism.

Severity: P0 — wire compatibility bug, core ACK mechanism broken.
